lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters are visible across the mid-lateral flank. These centroids are organized in a semi-regular grid pattern with higher intensity maxima appearing in the mid-section posterior to the pectoral fin attachment.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity run perpendicular to the longitudinal axis, intersecting with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a series of coordinate-like anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light (dorsal) to shadow (ventral) along the horizontal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin, visible in the lower-left quadrant, displays a high-density cluster of smaller, high-luminance spots that differ in scale and spatial frequency from the lateral flank patterning.
